description.en: Track whether AI shopping agents (ChatGPT, Gemini, Meta Muse, Amazon Rufus, Perplexity) recommend your products for real buyer questions, who they pick instead and why, and turn each gap into a sourced listing fix.
description.zh-CN: 追踪 AI 购物智能体（ChatGPT、Gemini、Meta Muse、Amazon Rufus、Perplexity）在买家提问时是否推荐你的商品、改推了谁、为什么，并把缺口变成有来源的商品修改。

agentPrompts: Run this week's check: ask each buyer question in ChatGPT, Gemini and Meta Muse and record where we rank.
Which high-priority buyer questions are we missing from, and who gets recommended instead?
Turn this week's gaps into listing fixes with a source for every new value.
